items.title: DocSkill: Skill-Integrated Agentic Reasoning for Multilingual Multi-Hop Document Question Answering
items.summary_1line: Multilingual multi-hop document question answering (MMHop-DocQA) requires locating and integrating evidence across complex layouts, document pages, and diverse languages. Existing approaches include single-pass proces...
items.editor_note: Adds an agentic, skill-based approach for multilingual multi-hop documents.

editorial.tldr: Three arXiv papers in five days attack question answering over structured content: tables in document images, knowledge graphs without labeled questions, and multilingual multi-hop documents. All three add structure or self-evaluation around the model instead of relying on a single pass.
editorial.whats_new: DocSkill (Oct 27) applies skill-integrated agentic reasoning to multilingual multi-hop document QA, where evidence spans complex layouts, pages and languages.
editorial.why_it_matters: Document and KG question answering is a common production RAG workload, and these papers move reliability gains into orchestration (iterative self-checks, skills, self-generated training signal) you can adopt without a new base model.
editorial.take_for_builders: If you run document or table QA in production, test an iterative self-check pass on your own failure cases before adopting any of these; none shows production-grade evidence yet.

status.detail: Research-stage papers only; no released code, benchmarks or production results are cited in this thread.
